info.name: Common Room Core Activities Website Visits API

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of visits to return per page

params.name: cursor
params.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response

params.name: cols
params.description:
Comma-separated list of additional columns to include in the response.
Valid column values: `url` (included by default), `contactId`, `organizationId`.
The meta column `recordCount` can be requested to return the total number
of matching visits in `meta.recordCount`.

params.name: contactId
params.description: Filter visits by prefixed contact ID (format `c_<number>`)

params.name: organizationId
params.description: Filter visits by prefixed organization ID (format `o_<number>`)

items.docs: Retrieve a paginated list of website visits.
